passages.text: This Master Services Agreement effective date is January 15, 2026 by and between Apex Corp and Zenith LLC. The initial agreement expiration date: December 31, 2028.
Section 9: Limitation of Liability. The total aggregate liability shall not exceed $2,500,000 USD. Either party may terminate with notice period of 30 calendar days.
For FY2026 Q3, total revenue was $14.2 billion, representing 18% year-over-year growth. Operating expenses reached $5.8 billion.
Net income of $3.4 billion was recorded, while EBITDA was $4.9 billion for the quarter. Cash and cash equivalents closed at $12.5 billion.

expected_facts.must_quote: Cash and cash equivalents closed at $12.5 billion

passages.text: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware without regard to conflict of law principles.
All invoice payment terms: Net 45 calendar days. Each party shall indemnify the other against third party claims.
